title: Stir-fried Boiled Chicken with Chinese Broccoli
description: A quick and easy Chinese-inspired dish made with boiled chicken, Chinese broccoli, and a savory sauce.
instructions: 1. Cut the boiled chicken into bite-sized pieces and set aside.
2. Cut the Chinese broccoli into florets and set aside.
3. Heat the cooking oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
4. Add the garlic and ginger and stir-fry for 1 minute.
5. Add the Chinese broccoli and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
6. Add the boiled chicken and stir-fry for another 2-3 minutes.
7. In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce and chili flakes.
8. Pour the soy sauce mixture over the chicken and broccoli and stir-fry for 1 minute.
9. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
